name: @afklink/i18n
description: AFKLink — user-facing text in Russian and English, one source for every surface.
//emit: Here emit only renders the Rust dictionary (--check) and writes nothing: the file lives in afklink-agent, which runs `bun contract/packages/i18n/scripts/emit.ts --out crates/i18n/src/generated.rs` from its root. With --cut it first re-cuts src/pc/{ru,en}.ts (the desktop client's share, `@afklink/i18n/pc`) from src/{ru,en}.ts with scripts/pc.ts, and skips the cut where that script is absent (the published desktop client).
